name.en: Salvinia paired floats and submerged leaf

description.en: A floating fern has paired surface leaves and a finely divided submerged leaf.
description.zh: 浮生蕨具有成对水面叶及细裂沉水叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Salvinia preauriculata; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Salvinia preauriculata 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Paired buoyant blades plus root-like submerged foliage differ from Azolla's scale-covered branching surface.
distinctness.zh: 成对浮叶及根状沉水叶区别于满江红鳞叶覆盖的分枝水面形态。

modeling_brief.en: Separate two broad float planes from a hanging forked bundle; label the latter as a leaf rather than true roots.
modeling_brief.zh: 把两片宽浮叶与下垂分叉束分开；后者标为叶而非真根。

uncertainty: Fine surface hairs are omitted; original water posture is inferred.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
